Zoox's part-time student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview

Analyze the coverage and exposure rate of interesting events in highway data; mind highway scenarios and build highway datasets; build dashboard to monitor highway data collection

Write Databricks notebooks to mine scenarios, create datasets, and build dashboards
Conduct exposure analysis to identity performance issues and data gaps by analyzing large-scale vehicle logs and simulation data
Write data analytic reports

ML

Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).

About Jerritt Canyon

The Jerritt Canyon deposit was discovered in 1972, and the first gold production from the property occurred in 1981. The Jerritt Canyon property contains 30,821 hectares of mining claims located in the mining-friendly state of Nevada. First Majestic acquired the Jerritt Canyon Gold Mine from Sprott Mining Inc. on April 30, 2021. In May 2023, operations were suspended to prioritize exploration and technical studies. Jerritt Canyon is now entering a new phase of evaluation and planning, requiring substantial technical support to advance the work necessary for a potential future restart of operations.

The Opportunity

The Senior Resource Geologist is responsible for geological modelling, mineral resource estimation, and block modelling, providing support to mine planning and mine operation for First Majestic Mines in the U.S. and Mexico.

Responsibilities

Interpret, develop and update geological models using Leapfrog-Geo and Leapfrog-Edge, analyzing relationships between mineralization, lithology, geological structures and alteration characteristics.
Conduct structural geology and geostatistics studies to improve mineral resources understanding.
Perform drillholes database evaluation and utilize QAQC protocols to validate data integrity for geological modelling and mineral resource estimation.
Review, update, and validate short-term and long-term block models with Mine Reconciliation of production vs resources estimates.
Collaborate with Support to Geology Exploration team in gold deposits, identifying mineral resource extension opportunities, and assisting with drilling programs.
Prepare and review resource models and data tables for annual/bi-annual long-term mineral resource statements in compliance with international standards and guidelines.
Up to 10% travel to Mexico to attend meetings.

Minimum Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Geology or Earth Science or a related field, or foreign degree equivalent, and 5 years of experience in mineral resource estimation. This experience must include:
3 years of experience in a mining environment, including geological modelling, resource modelling and block modelling, providing support to mine planning.
3 years of experience with 3D Geological modelling software such as Leapfrog Geo and Leapfrog Edge.
3 years of experience supporting a Geology Exploration team in gold deposits.
3 years of experience supporting a drilling program.
3 years of experience in structural geology and geostatistics.
3 years of experience in drillhole database evaluation and QAQC protocols.
3 years of experience in mineral resource statements in compliance with international standards and guidelines.

Requires SEG or AIPG membership or equivalent.

Experience may be gained concurrently.

Location of Employment

Full time, 40 hours per week position at Jerritt Canyon Gold LLC in Elko, NV. Up to 10% travel to Mexico to attend meetings.

Proven data science skillset, including:
Driver and root‑cause analysis
Time‑series forecasting and trend analysis
Segmentation and exploratory modeling
Applying AI/ML techniques to real business problems

Sponsorship

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Part-Time Student Worker Program

Zoox's part-time student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview

Analyze the coverage and exposure rate of interesting events in highway data; mind highway scenarios and build highway datasets; build dashboard to monitor highway data collection

Responsibilities

Write Databricks notebooks to mine scenarios, create datasets, and build dashboards
Conduct exposure analysis to identity performance issues and data gaps by analyzing large-scale vehicle logs and simulation data
Write data analytic reports

Required Qualifications

Experience working with time-series or sensor data
Familiarity with robotics or AV data is a plus

Bonus Qualifications

ML
Robotics

Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience).
Available to commit to a minimum six month assignment.
Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week.
Able to work on-site at one of our office locations (Foster City).
Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

About Jerritt Canyon

The Jerritt Canyon deposit was discovered in 1972, and the first gold production from the property occurred in 1981. The Jerritt Canyon property contains 30,821 hectares of mining claims located in the mining-friendly state of Nevada. First Majestic acquired the Jerritt Canyon Gold Mine from Sprott Mining Inc. on April 30, 2021. In May 2023, operations were suspended to prioritize exploration and technical studies. Jerritt Canyon is now entering a new phase of evaluation and planning, requiring substantial technical support to advance the work necessary for a potential future restart of operations.

The Opportunity

The Senior Resource Geologist is responsible for geological modelling, mineral resource estimation, and block modelling, providing support to mine planning and mine operation for First Majestic Mines in the U.S. and Mexico.

Responsibilities

Interpret, develop and update geological models using Leapfrog-Geo and Leapfrog-Edge, analyzing relationships between mineralization, lithology, geological structures and alteration characteristics.
Conduct structural geology and geostatistics studies to improve mineral resources understanding.
Perform drillholes database evaluation and utilize QAQC protocols to validate data integrity for geological modelling and mineral resource estimation.
Review, update, and validate short-term and long-term block models with Mine Reconciliation of production vs resources estimates.
Collaborate with Support to Geology Exploration team in gold deposits, identifying mineral resource extension opportunities, and assisting with drilling programs.
Prepare and review resource models and data tables for annual/bi-annual long-term mineral resource statements in compliance with international standards and guidelines.
Up to 10% travel to Mexico to attend meetings.

Minimum Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Geology or Earth Science or a related field, or foreign degree equivalent, and 5 years of experience in mineral resource estimation. This experience must include:
3 years of experience in a mining environment, including geological modelling, resource modelling and block modelling, providing support to mine planning.
3 years of experience with 3D Geological modelling software such as Leapfrog Geo and Leapfrog Edge.
3 years of experience supporting a Geology Exploration team in gold deposits.
3 years of experience supporting a drilling program.

The Division of Medical Physics in the Department of Radiation Oncology is seeking a Residency Program Coordinator 2, to manage, administer and support the operations of the Medical Physics residency program, postdoctoral scholars and visiting students. The Stanford Medical Physics residency program is accredited by the CAMPEP -- Commission on Accreditation of Medical Physics Education Programs.

Promote Culture of Safety: Demonstrates commitment to personal responsibility and value for safety; communicates safety concerns; uses and promotes safe behaviors based on training and lessons learned.

Responsibilities

Core Duties
:

Independently implement, administer and evaluate day-to-day activities of residency/clinical fellowship program(s) by identifying and executing responsibilities, making recommendations that impact policies, programs and standards, and ensuring compliance and follow-up, as needed.
Act as key contact for the program to interpret and apply complex policies, procedures and program guidelines (such as those from ACGME – Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education). Agile and quick learner who can adapt easily to Stanford specific software and clinically related software.
Demonstrated ability to work well independently and take initiative while problem solving and resolving challenges.
Excellent oral and written communication skills. Ability to work with all levels of faculty and staff, and exhibit significant degree of diplomacy.
Excellent customer service skills and ability to adapt to changing work environment.
